title: Russia Targets Ukraine with Glide Bombs
summary: On [date], Russia launched an attack on the Zaporizhzhia nuclear power plant in southern Ukraine, striking it with eight glide bombs over a period of 90 minutes. The Ukrainian military claimed that the attack was intended to disrupt their operations and gain strategic advantage. The Russian government denied any involvement in the attack. Meanwhile, gas shortages have been reported across Ukraine as the country seeks to cut off its fuel supply from Russia.
